phases.name: Foundation
deliverables: Cloud infrastructure provisioned (GCP project, VPC, IAM policies)
Data model for supplier emissions (BigQuery schema + versioning)
SAP S/4HANA integration adapter (BAPI connector with retry logic)
CI/CD pipeline with automated testing gates
Data governance framework and access control matrix
risks: SAP BAPI rate limits may require throttling strategy
IAM policy complexity across 14-country data residency

phases.name: Core Pipeline
deliverables: Supplier data extraction service (batch + real-time)
Emissions factor database with GHG Protocol mappings
Calculation engine implementing ISO 14064-1 methodology
Data quality scoring and validation framework
Multi-language normalization pipeline (8 languages)
Anomaly detection for emissions data outliers
dependencies: Foundation phase: SAP integration adapter must be operational
Foundation phase: Data model must be finalized
risks: Supplier data quality varies significantly across regions
Emissions factor mapping coverage for niche materials

phases.name: Reporting & Compliance
deliverables: CSRD-compliant reporting engine with XBRL output
Audit trail system with immutable event log
Executive dashboard with drill-down by supplier/region/category
Quarterly submission workflow with approval gates
Data lineage visualization for regulatory reviewers
dependencies: Core Pipeline phase: Calculation engine must be validated
Core Pipeline phase: Data quality framework must be operational
risks: CSRD reporting format may evolve during implementation
Audit trail storage costs for high-volume supplier events

phases.name: Optimization
deliverables: ML model for emissions factor gap filling (missing supplier data)
Predictive anomaly detection with drift monitoring
Performance optimization for 10x supplier scale (24,000 suppliers)
Self-service onboarding portal for new suppliers
Operational runbook and knowledge transfer documentation
dependencies: Reporting & Compliance phase: Audit trail must be operational
Core Pipeline phase: Anomaly detection baseline established
risks: ML model accuracy depends on training data volume
10x scale testing requires realistic load generation
